purpose: Learn which inferred event spans merit retrieval based on downstream binary outcomes, not simply event duration

task.hidden_context_to_label: deterministic seed-dependent preference for two distinct labels (simulator-side only)
task.candidate_events: spans inferred from public raw 0..3 tokens by frozen HMM or raw run segmentation
task.selection: span index, no hidden boundaries or target labels in learner
task.feedback: only terminal boolean whether true hidden label at selected span center matches hidden context preference
task.absence: may be impossible in some episodes; report achievable privileged oracle coverage

model.update: per-context per-decoded-label Beta-smoothed success counts, bounded UCB exploration during train, frozen greedy evaluation
model.trace: versioned model-bound episode log; replay choices and reward evidence; no authentication

baselines: contextual reward-only raw-run bandit same episode budget
metrics: selected event reward success per cohort/family
limits: The event-state alphabet is fixed to four, the context cue and feedback type are engineered
The target label is simulator hidden truth only; no hidden labels or true spans enter model propose/update
Do not modify this protocol or evaluation seeds after observing scores
Previously inspected seeds are not blind, no D3/D4 completion claims
No automatic model promotion, external actions, identity or memory access
Preserve v2A prior to overlapping v2B
